rationale.usefulness: Gives an operator one number per channel: the context window is the only one worth protecting (41% of 20-call output; a longer cap is the lever); memory notes, memory size, history search and repo-naming chat buy nothing measurable. Flags chat after an erasure (+22%) as a cheap candidate lever. Not holdout-confirmed; the chat effect is not an intervention.
